pooling: None: six-real cost and twelve-synthetic exact quality/cost use separate matched cohorts.
synthetic_interval_scope: Bootstrap over declared generator-case groups; not real-population uncertainty.
synthetic_comparison_scope: Preplanned secondary controlled budget comparison, not a substitute for real accuracy.

serial_pilot.scope: Historical development protocol and serial pilot cohort only; different grammar/token protocol from final main run. No matched speedup inference.

main_last_invocation.scope: New episodes in the recorded last invocation, including model setup; not serial episode latency

timing_scope: Overview/generation/action spans only; verification shares the GPU lock but has no dedicated CUDA timer. Equal per-request allocation is incomplete, schedule-dependent accounting, not pure model time, standalone latency or marginal/billable GPU cost. Episode wall time includes waits.
calibration: No probabilities or calibration curves inferred from contrast.
caption: Separate matched real recorded spans and exact synthetic quality/accounting comparisons. Synthetic intervals resample generator-case groups only. Verification shares the GPU lock but lacks dedicated timing; recorded CUDA accounting is incomplete and schedule-dependent. Real risk–coverage remains unavailable; serial latency and concurrent throughput are distinct.
